```{r}
#| include: false
root <- normalizePath(here::here())
if (!exists("FAMILY", inherits = FALSE) ||
    length(FAMILY) != 1L ||
    !FAMILY %in% c("ppv", "ppa")) {
  stop("residuals: set exactly one response family.", call. = FALSE)
}
.MODEL_CONFIG <- jsonlite::read_json(
  file.path(root, "scripts", "manifest.json"), simplifyVector = TRUE
)
.MODEL_IDS <- as.character(.MODEL_CONFIG$responses$names)
.MODEL_IDS <- .MODEL_IDS[
  grepl(sprintf("^%s([LTV])?$", FAMILY), .MODEL_IDS)
]
.MODEL_SUFFIX <- sub(sprintf("^%s", FAMILY), "", .MODEL_IDS)
.MODEL_KEYS <- ifelse(.MODEL_SUFFIX == "", "resultant", .MODEL_SUFFIX)
if (!length(.MODEL_IDS) ||
    any(!.MODEL_KEYS %in% c("resultant", "L", "T", "V"))) {
  stop(sprintf("residuals: invalid %s response family.", FAMILY),
       call. = FALSE)
}
if (!exists("FAMILY_LABEL", inherits = FALSE)) {
  FAMILY_LABEL <- toupper(FAMILY)
}
if (!exists("COMPONENT_LABELS", inherits = FALSE)) {
  COMPONENT_LABELS <- c(
    resultant = "resultant",
    L = "longitudinal",
    T = "transverse",
    V = "vertical"
  )
}
.MODEL_AXIS_LABELS <- c(
  resultant = "resultant",
  L = "longitudinal",
  T = "transverse",
  V = "vertical"
)
RESP <- setNames(
  paste(unname(COMPONENT_LABELS[.MODEL_KEYS]), FAMILY_LABEL),
  .MODEL_IDS
)
.MODEL_AXIS <- setNames(
  paste(unname(.MODEL_AXIS_LABELS[.MODEL_KEYS]), FAMILY_LABEL),
  .MODEL_IDS
)
TABS <- setNames(
  paste(tools::toTitleCase(unname(COMPONENT_LABELS[.MODEL_KEYS])), FAMILY_LABEL),
  .MODEL_IDS
)
DATASET <- "QDS"
if (!DATASET %in% names(.MODEL_CONFIG$datasets)) {
  stop("residuals: dataset QDS is not declared in the manifest.",
       call. = FALSE)
}
.MODEL_UNITS <- jsonlite::read_json(
  file.path(root, "data", "domains", "units.json"), simplifyVector = TRUE
)
UNIT <- as.character(.MODEL_UNITS[[FAMILY]])
if (length(UNIT) != 1L || is.na(UNIT) || !nzchar(UNIT)) {
  stop(sprintf("residuals: units.json does not define %s.", FAMILY),
       call. = FALSE)
}
PathResiduals <- file.path(root, "data", "summary", "residuals_oof.csv")
PathSources <- file.path(root, "data", "domains", "sources.csv")
if (any(!file.exists(c(PathResiduals, PathSources)))) {
  stop("residuals: required OOF products are missing.", call. = FALSE)
}
if (!exists("CAP1", inherits = FALSE)) {
  CAP1 <- "%s: signed OOF residual (observed minus predicted) versus the retained OOF prediction. The horizontal line marks zero residual and symbols identify the observation source."
}
if (!exists("CAP2", inherits = FALSE)) {
  CAP2 <- "%s: distribution of signed OOF residuals (observed minus predicted) on the $\\log_{10}$ scale. Their empirical quantiles define the p50, p90, and p95 levels."
}
if (!exists("X_AXIS_SCATTER", inherits = FALSE)) {
  X_AXIS_SCATTER <- "OOF prediction of %s [%s]"
}
if (!exists("Y_AXIS_SCATTER", inherits = FALSE)) {
  Y_AXIS_SCATTER <- "Residual [log10]"
}
if (!exists("X_AXIS_HIST", inherits = FALSE)) {
  X_AXIS_HIST <- "OOF residual of %s [log10]"
}
if (!exists("Y_AXIS_HIST", inherits = FALSE)) Y_AXIS_HIST <- "Frequency"
if (!exists("GROUP_LEGEND", inherits = FALSE)) GROUP_LEGEND <- "Source"
if (!exists("SOURCE_UNKNOWN", inherits = FALSE)) {
  SOURCE_UNKNOWN <- "Unclassified"
}
if (!exists("ZERO_LABEL", inherits = FALSE)) ZERO_LABEL <- "zero"
if (!exists("SERIES", inherits = FALSE)) {
  SERIES <- c(histogram = "Histogram", density = "Density")
}
```

::: {.panel-tabset .full-width}

```{r}
#| results: asis
#| echo: false
#| eval: !expr knitr::is_html_output()
for (.ID in names(RESP)) {
  cat(sprintf("\n#### %s\n\n", TABS[[.ID]]))
  NGR::knitBlock(
    path = "/_fig/residuals.cell.qmd",
    stem = sprintf("fresid-%s", .ID),
    labels = "rewrite",
    vars = list(
      DATASET = DATASET,
      ID = .ID,
      RESPONSE_LABEL = .MODEL_AXIS[[.ID]],
      X_AXIS_SCATTER = sprintf(X_AXIS_SCATTER, .MODEL_AXIS[[.ID]], UNIT),
      Y_AXIS_SCATTER = Y_AXIS_SCATTER,
      X_AXIS_HIST = sprintf(X_AXIS_HIST, .MODEL_AXIS[[.ID]]),
      Y_AXIS_HIST = Y_AXIS_HIST,
      GROUP_LEGEND = GROUP_LEGEND,
      SOURCE_UNKNOWN = SOURCE_UNKNOWN,
      ZERO_LABEL = ZERO_LABEL,
      SERIES = SERIES,
      PathResiduals = PathResiduals,
      PathSources = PathSources,
      CAPTION1 = sprintf(CAP1, RESP[[.ID]]),
      CAPTION2 = sprintf(CAP2, RESP[[.ID]])
    ),
    root = root
  )
}
```

:::

```{r}
#| include: false
rm(CAP1, CAP2, COMPONENT_LABELS, DATASET, FAMILY, FAMILY_LABEL,
   GROUP_LEGEND, PathResiduals, PathSources, RESP, SERIES, SOURCE_UNKNOWN,
   TABS, UNIT, X_AXIS_HIST, X_AXIS_SCATTER, Y_AXIS_HIST, Y_AXIS_SCATTER,
   ZERO_LABEL)
rm(.MODEL_CONFIG, .MODEL_IDS, .MODEL_KEYS, .MODEL_SUFFIX, .MODEL_UNITS,
   .MODEL_AXIS, .MODEL_AXIS_LABELS)
if (knitr::is_html_output()) rm(.ID)
```
